description: About Northwind Labs Northwind Labs builds AI assistants that teams use inside the tools they already work in. We are a team that ships, measures and says plainly what worked. About the role We are hiring a Principal Product Manager for Retrieval. Our products run on LLM pipelines with RAG and agentic workflows, so you will work closely with machine learning engineers. You will report to the head of product and work from Remote - US. What you will do • Manage stakeholder expectations across sales, support and leadership. • Evaluate build, buy and vendor options and make a recommendation you can defend. • Own the roadmap for Retrieval, from customer discovery through launch and iteration. • Define success metrics, instrument them, and report on them without being asked. • Run experiments, read the results honestly, and stop work that is not paying off. What you bring • Clear writing, and the habit of putting decisions in writing. • 10+ years of product management experience, including B2B or enterprise products. Why Northwind Labs Competitive pay and equity, real ownership of a product area, and colleagues who will tell you when they disagree. We consider every qualified applicant.
